description: On the table in front of you there’s a white lamp-shaped piece next to two white base parts, with a red backdrop behind them. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the lamp-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it toward the base, while the left hand stays near the base to steady and align it; then the right hand lowers the lamp piece onto the base and makes small adjustments as both hands keep the base stable as a two-hand object.
